frozen_before: training, validation checkpoint scoring and fresh test acquisition scoring
source: Same pinned OpenFF Sage 2.2.1 QM archive; one complete 24-point 1D scan per nonstereo parent
training: All eligible molecules sharing only the previous development scaffolds (95 planned parents)
quarantine: All previous test scaffolds excluded from training, validation and fresh test
fresh: Exclude ALL previous development and test scaffolds; SHA256(qlora-split-v1 + scaffold) modulo 5 = 0 validation, otherwise fresh test (30/168 planned parents)
qc: Query public QCArchive metadata before teacher scoring. Exclude all non-complete records without replacement; verify Psi4 B3LYP-D3BJ/DZVP including synonymous b3lyp-d3(bj)
teacher: For train and validation parents only, replay each of five existing strategies across five matched seeds, score mean normalized error-query AUC; no fresh test performance in training/checkpoint selection
loss: Soft cross entropy on A-E option logits against softmax(-strategy AUC / 0.05). One update averages all five cyclic option permutations for one molecule
model: Existing pinned Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 4-bit MLX base; freeze all original weights
selection: Lowest validation molecule-mean normalized acquisition AUC among nonzero checkpoints; tie chooses earliest. Base model evaluated as an independent matched-prompt control
prompt: Compact graph, mapped driven dihedral graph context, bond descriptors, unlabeled pool angles and five action formulas. No few-shot examples or energies; exactly one A-E decision
test: One decision each for base and selected fine-tuned model; five acquisition initial seeds; same Fourier model/4 initial/12 budget/2 batch/16 pool/8 evaluation points as previous experiment
baselines: ExtraTrees multioutput strategy-regret predictor with Morgan and chemical/coverage features
primary: Fine-tuned LLM minus Bayes mean normalized error-query AUC, averaging five seeds within each parent, scaffold-cluster bootstrap 10000 draws, two-sided 95% CI; beat Bayes only if upper bound below 0
secondary: Comparisons with rule, matched base LLM, learned non-LLM selector, training-global strategy; final centered residual RMSE and latency. Descriptive intervals, no independent benefit claim without primary success
test_sealed_until: Adapter checkpoint selected using validation only; no retraining or prompt changes after fresh test scoring
limitations: Only 37 training scaffold groups in existing corpus; this is a small fine-tuning pilot
Existing public QM data may have been seen during LLM pretraining
Acquisition replay at QM-optimized geometries does not establish prospective QM wall-time savings or MD force-field accuracy
